findings.summary: D6 relocates the key description to hover text, contradicting FR7/AC 22.9 'unchanged behaviour' and dropping the existing selectable description surface (Req 14.2).
findings.fix: Keep the description as a visible, selectable element (same-row secondary weak label after the value, or a second line under the key row) and state the alignment column is computed only from the key-label line. A real change to description display needs the requirements gate.

findings.summary: D5 renders the key path as a single RichText::monospace label for alignment, which drops the current selectable key-name button (Req 14.2) and does not state the styling that keeps the char-count->pixel-width assumption valid.
findings.fix: State explicitly that the padded key path is a non-interactive RichText::monospace label (no button frame/padding) so char-count width holds, and confirm whether the selectable key-name must be preserved; if so, specify how (transparent selectable_label sized to the padded text).

findings.summary: Save button + 'Unsaved edits : <yes|no>' placement is ambiguous ('same row or immediately adjacent'); interacts with the Tab-order caveat since Save is interactive and must not precede the Filter field.
findings.fix: Pick one layout: keep Filter+Save as the first header row with Filter TextEdit allocated before the Save button (preserving first-Tab=Filter), and render 'Unsaved edits : yes|no' as a non-interactive label row below it.

findings.summary: D9 overstates render.rs proximity to the 400-line budget; it is ~297 non-test lines (407 total incl. tests), ~100 lines of headroom.
findings.fix: Restate the premise with the real ~297 non-test count; keep the conditional layout.rs split and extract-if-approaching guidance.

findings.summary: D5's grid-rejection rationale is substantively correct but cites 'the keys_editor panel' whereas the documented evidence is in keys_editor_panel/render.rs, not shell/keys_editor.rs.
findings.fix: Cite keys_editor_panel/render.rs as the source of the documented Grid/ScrollArea cell-collapse behaviour.

findings.summary: AC 22.4 vs FR3 connector-set divergence (FR3 lists a vertical continuation bar) is resolved by the two-level model but not called out in D4.
findings.fix: Add one sentence in D4 noting FR3's vertical continuation bar does not apply (no intermediate levels in a two-level tree), so only tee/L are drawn, matching AC 22.4.

findings.summary: The 'Macro Library header' alignment-idiom precedent cited in D5/tech-stack was not located during verification; calendar_header.rs and the POM calendar precedents are confirmed.
findings.fix: Cite the exact Macro Library file/function or drop the reference; the calendar_header.rs precedent alone justifies the idiom.
